scripts.experiment:core: npx --yes concurrently -n web,recorder,monitor -c blue,green,magenta "npm run serve:https" "node scripts/run-python.cjs scripts/aura_recorder.py --wss" "npm run monitor"
scripts.experiment: npm run setup:python && npm run experiment:core
scripts.experiment:mock: npx --yes concurrently -n web,mock,monitor -c blue,yellow,magenta "npm run serve:https" "node scripts/run-python.cjs scripts/mock_recorder.py --wss" "npm run monitor"
scripts.package:monitor: npm run build --prefix monitor-electron && npm run package:mac --prefix monitor-electron
scripts.package:monitor:win: npm run build --prefix monitor-electron && npm run package:win --prefix monitor-electron
scripts.package:standalone:win: npm run build:standalone && npm run package:standalone:win --prefix monitor-electron
scripts.package:standalone:mac: npm run build:standalone && npm run package:standalone:mac --prefix monitor-electron
